doc.title: Arturo Sandoval interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 12, 2023

title: Imitating Harry James and Louis Armstrong
summary: Prompted by Joe Wilder's tone, he says he is a chameleon and plays imitations of Harry James and Louis.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: Yes. It reminds me of a dear friend of mine, Joe Wilder who had that big, beautiful, mellow tone.

Also for example, nowadays a lot of trumpet players don’t even have a clue who was Bunny Berigan or Harry James. I love Harry James’ sound. I love Harry James’ sound. And I do a good imitation of him. Because I’ve been like a kind of a — how would I say — like a chameleon. I’ve been a kind of chameleon all my life because I pay attention and I want to learn the nuances and specific detail of all the great players that I admire and respect. And this is my Harry James.
Yeah, it takes me back to the ballroom.
Absolutely. In fact here’s a little bit of my Louis:
